desc: The Bristol line of Side by Sides delivers beauty, elegance, and performance. Featuring an English Stock with Case Colored receiver. Available in four gauges, each built on a true steel frame with precision laser engraved detail. The Bristol comes standard with Select Turkish walnut, auto ejectors, 5 chokes Beretta Mobil (SK, IC, M, IM, F), brass bead front sight and a selective top tang safety. A Side by Side with competition grade craftsmanship at Field Grade pricing.
